notes: Sixteen lists read. oecd.org returned 403, so OECD entries are the framework's Knowledge and skills and Subjective well-being dimensions as named in docs/spec/pains/pain-inventory.md, with Survey of Adult Skills 2023 averages taken from NALA's factsheet and the NEET passage from TUAC's summary of How's Life 2024. The 211 2025 Impact Snapshot and WHO/IHME cause-of-burden lists were checked; no category bears on Purpose, so they are not recorded as lists. Pew's 'Where Americans find meaning in life' (2018) was read but lists sources of meaning, not pains, so it is not a list here. Wikidata QIDs came from about 10 wbsearchentities lookups before the API rate-limited this session; no QID was found for limited English proficiency, NEET or dropping out. Overlaps for refine: meaning-in-life with meaningless-work (Meaning, work only) and stuck; dont-know-what-i-want with no-path (which assumes the person knows what they want); no-time-to-learn with learning; reading, everyday-math and computers sit under need-skills; english may also belong to People or Home for new arrivals. Harvard's figures are for U.S. young adults (18-25), not all adults; ESDE figures are EU adults who wanted more training.
